subject.title: fix(agents): handle stdout stream errors in shell snapshot runShell

question: Should maintainers route this stdout-pipe bug through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100744, or ask this PR to be reshaped to the same stdio-ignore production-path fix?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same current-main bug, but the stronger related PR is not proof-positive enough for an automatic supersession close and this branch is a weaker mitigation.

options.title: Use the stronger related PR as canonical
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100744 as the landing path once proof/CI gates clear, then close or decline this duplicate branch with that context.

options.title: Ask this branch to align
options.body: Keep this PR active only if the contributor replaces the listener/test-export approach with the stdio-ignore production-path shape and real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept the listener mitigation
options.body: Merge the smaller listener-only change after proof, accepting that it leaves the unused pipe and test-only export in place.

recommendation.title: Use the stronger related PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100744 as the landing path once proof/CI gates clear, then close or decline this duplicate branch with that context.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc pushed the stronger related repair and has recent shell-snapshot history, making them the best available owner for the canonical-path choice.
